title.narrative: Partners Emergency workshop and learning exchange Feb 2025

description.narrative:
A humanitarian workshop for all CAM partners in the region is being co-created with the Red Jesuita Migrante (RJM).
Originally, the workshop was only going to target jesuit entities linked to the RJM, under CAC068. Then it was discussed that if the training was already been organised, other CAFOD partners could also benefit from it. Considering the funds under CAC068 were limited and they will only cover RJM representatives (and not other CAFOD partner representatives) we have allocated additional funding to this task. It will also cover some representatives from Caritas Haiti as per discussions with ESRT. The workshop is being led by RJM under the work of CAC068, CAFOD is contributing to the expenses of adding additional participants to the workshop.
The agenda is being co-developed with RJM but the main areas to cover are the following ones: - Humanitarian principles and essential humanitarian norm & Sphere standards - The context of emergencies within Central America - Decision making: Experiences with CASH and other sectors of intervention. - Articulation and coordination, including actors mapping - Preparedness actions - roles and responsibilities - Actions to undertake beforehand to be ready: Suppliers, needs assessments, etc - Types of emergency responses - Risk management - Planning PPE for partners - START Fund - how does it work
